messages:
Maya Rivera: Hi team, I'm on my first week and following the VPN onboarding. Okta Gateway shows connected but I can't reach the bastion IP (10.1.2.3). SSH just hangs. Anyone seen this with macOS + Okta agent?
Samir Khan: welcome! quick checklist: 1) did you finish the Okta browser MFA prompt? 2) which network interface shows the VPN (ppp0/tun0)? 3) can you paste the output of `ifconfig` or the route table?
Maya Rivera: did MFA earlier but not sure it re-applied. here's the route lines i see: `10.0.0.0/8 via 169.254.2.1 on ppp0` and `default via 192.0.2.1 en0`. traceroute to 10.1.2.3 stops after the VPN gw.
Samir Khan: sounds like split-tunnel policy or stale session push. sometimes Okta only pushes DNS or specific domain routes. two quick fixes: a) re-auth the Okta Gateway (browser MFA) to force policy push, b) add a temporary host route locally: `sudo route -n add -net 10.0.0.0/8 169.254.2.1` (replace gw if different).
Maya Rivera: tried re-auth via browser, okta-bot asked for MFA and then said connected, but still can't ssh. I added the route Samir suggested and now SSH connects.
infra-bot: Maya Rivera's IAM binding for corp-ssh is in pending state. Infra needs to approve `corp-ssh-access` tag before console-based SSM sessions will work. Please file an infra request with your employee ID if you haven't.
Maya Rivera: thanks, I just filed the request in #eng-infra with @infra and my employee id.
Samir Khan: for the docs: let's add a step on the new-hire guide that after installing Okta Gateway you must complete the browser MFA to ensure corp routes are pushed. also note a fallback route command for mac/linux if people hit the bastion timeout.
Maya Rivera: copying the exact commands here in case others need them: `sudo route -n add -net 10.0.0.0/8 169.254.2.1` and `ssh -i ~/.ssh/id_rsa ec2-user@10.1.2.3`. also FYI my ssh key needed to be added in the console profile.
okta-bot: Okta Gateway session refreshed for Maya Rivera. MFA confirmed.
Maya Rivera: all good now, thanks both! added a note to my onboarding checklist about "re-auth Okta Gateway and verify corp routes". :tada:
